details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers K1 (financial performance), K2 (net loans and interest rates), K3 (Estonian market revitalization), and K7 (Botanica Lozen project progress). However, it omits core material details for K4 (Rannakalda sales specifics), K5 (Soodi 6 project details), K6 (Arco Vara development site acquisition), K8 (Arcojärve project status), K9 (Kodulahe development planning), and K10 (Merivälja Kuldlehe project status). These omissions represent significant portions of the required material information, resulting in a mixed coverage level.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected, with no self-contradictions. The narrative flows from overall financial improvement (S1) through revenue and profit details (S2-S3), supporting factors (S4, S10-S11), operational developments (S12-S15), and concludes with an integrated assessment of the quarter's significance and future outlook (S16-S17). There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization groups related information effectively (market conditions, operational execution, financial metrics). While S5 and S6 note cash constraints and increased outflows, these are presented as expected challenges within the capital-intensive context and do not contradict the overall profitability improvement. The summary forms a clear, logical whole without material internal inconsistencies.
